    r.image t = s.image t := by
  /-
    α : Type u_1
    β : Type u_2
    r s : Rel α β
    h : LE.le r s
    t : Set α
    ht : ∀ (x : α), Membership.mem t x → LE.le (s x) (r x)
    ⊢ Eq (r.image t) (s.image t)
  -/
  ext y
  /-
    case h
    α : Type u_1
    β : Type u_2
    r s : Rel α β
    h : LE.le r s
    t : Set α
    ht : ∀ (x : α), Membership.mem t x → LE.le (s x) (r x)
    y : β
    ⊢ Iff (Membership.mem (r.image t) y) (Membership.mem (s.image t) y)
  -/
  constructor
    /-
      case h.mp
      α : Type u_1
      β : Type u_2
      r s : Rel α β
      h : LE.le r s
      t : Set α
      ht : ∀ (x : α), Membership.mem t x → LE.le (s x) (r x)
      y : β
      ⊢ Membership.mem (r.image t) y → Membership.mem (s.image t) y
    -/
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, hy⟩
    /-
      case h.mp.intro.intro
      α : Type u_1
      β : Type u_2
      r s : Rel α β
      h : LE.le r s
      t : Set α
      ht : ∀ (x : α), Membership.mem t x → LE.le (s x) (r x)
      y : β
      x : α
      hx : Membership.mem t x
      hy : r x y
      ⊢ Membership.mem (s.image t) y
    -/
    exact ⟨x, hx, h x y hy⟩
    /-
      🎉 no goals
    -/
    /-
      case h.mpr
      α : Type u_1
      β : Type u_2
      r s : Rel α β
      h : LE.le r s
      t : Set α
      ht : ∀ (x : α), Membership.mem t x → LE.le (s x) (r x)
      y : β
      ⊢ Membership.mem (s.image t) y → Membership.mem (r.image t) y
    -/
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, hy⟩
    /-
      case h.mpr.intro.intro
      α : Type u_1
      β : Type u_2
      r s : Rel α β
      h : LE.le r s
      t : Set α
      ht : ∀ (x : α), Membership.mem t x → LE.le (s x) (r x)
      y : β
      x : α
      hx : Membership.mem t x
      hy : s x y
      ⊢ Membership.mem (r.image t) y
    -/
    exact ⟨x, hx, ht x hx y hy⟩
    /-
      🎉 no goals
    -/

C1_dependencies.name: Set
C1_dependencies.content:
/-- A set is a collection of elements of some type `α`.

Although `Set` is defined as `α → Prop`, this is an implementation detail which should not be
relied on. Instead, `setOf` and membership of a set (`∈`) should be used to convert between sets
and predicates.
-/
def Set (α : Type u) := α → Prop

def field (r : Rel α α) : Set α :=
  r.dom ∪ r.codom

structure Injective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  injective : ∀ ⦃x₁ x₂ y⦄, r x₁ y → r x₂ y → x₁ = x₂

@[mk_iff]
structure Coinjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  coinjective : ∀ ⦃y₁ y₂ x⦄, r x y₁ → r x y₂ → y₁ = y₂

@[mk_iff]
structure Surjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  surjective : ∀ y, ∃ x, r x y

@[mk_iff]
structure Cosurjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  cosurjective : ∀ x, ∃ y, r x y

@[mk_iff]
structure Functional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Coinjective, r.Cosurjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure Cofunctional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Injective, r.Surjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure OneOne (r : Rel α β) extends r.Injective, r.Coinjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure Bijective (r : Rel α β) extends r.Functional, r.Cofunctional : Prop

  codom_eq_dom : r.codom = r.dom

structure Permutative (r : Rel α α) extends r.OneOne, r.CodomEqDom : Prop

theorem CodomEqDom.dom_union_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) :
    r.dom ∪ r.codom = r.dom := by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom, union_self]

theorem CodomEqDom.mem_dom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) {x y : α} (hxy : r x y) :
    y ∈ r.dom := by
  rw [← h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨x, hxy⟩

theorem CodomEqDom.mem_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) {x y : α} (hxy : r x y) :

  rw [h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨y, hxy⟩

theorem codomEqDom_iff' (r : Rel α α) :
    r.CodomEqDom ↔ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r y z) ∧ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r z x) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h⟩
    rw [Set.ext_iff] at h
    constructor
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h y).mp ⟨x, hxy⟩
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h x).mpr ⟨y, hxy⟩
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    constructor
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩
      exact h₁ y x hxy
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩
      exact h₂ x y hxy

  ⟨⟨h.coinjective⟩, ⟨h.injective⟩⟩

theorem inv_apply {r : Rel α β} {x : α} {y : β} :
    r.inv y x ↔ r x y :=
  Iff.rfl

theorem inv_injective : Function.Injective (inv : Rel α β → Rel β α) := by

  exact congr_fun₂ h b a

@[simp]
theorem inv_inj {r s : Rel α β} : r.inv = s.inv ↔ r = s :=

@[simp]

theorem Injective.image_injective {r : Rel α β} (h : r.Injective) {s t : Set α}
    (hs : s ⊆ r.dom) (ht : t ⊆ r.dom) (hst : r.image s = r.image t) : s = t := by
  rw [Set.ext_iff] at hst ⊢
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ := hs hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := (hst y).mp ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
    cases h.injective hxy hzy
    exact hz
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ := ht hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := (hst y).mpr ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
    cases h.injective hxy hzy
    exact hz

theorem subset_image_of_preimage_subset {r : Rel α β} {s : Set β} (hs : s ⊆ r.codom) (t : Set α) :
    r.preimage s ⊆ t → s ⊆ r.image t := by
  intro hst y hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hs hy
  exact ⟨x, hst ⟨y, hy, hx⟩, hx⟩

theorem Injective.preimage_subset_of_subset_image {r : Rel α β} (h : r.Injective)

    s ⊆ r.image t → r.preimage s ⊆ t := by
  rintro hst x ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩

    r.preimage s ⊆ t ↔ s ⊆ r.image t :=

  have h₁ := h.preimage_subset_iff_subset_image s hs t

  rw [preimage_inv, inv_image] at h₂
  rw [subset_antisymm_iff, subset_antisymm_iff, h₁, h₂, and_comm]

theorem CodomEqDom.dom_union_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) :
    r.dom ∪ r.codom = r.dom := by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom, union_self]

theorem CodomEqDom.mem_dom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) {x y : α} (hxy : r x y) :
    y ∈ r.dom := by
  rw [← h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨x, hxy⟩

theorem CodomEqDom.mem_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) {x y : α} (hxy : r x y) :
    x ∈ r.codom := by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨y, hxy⟩

/-- An elementary description of the property `CodomEqDom`. -/
theorem codomEqDom_iff' (r : Rel α α) :
    r.CodomEqDom ↔ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r y z) ∧ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r z x) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h⟩
    rw [Set.ext_iff] at h
    constructor
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h y).mp ⟨x, hxy⟩
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h x).mpr ⟨y, hxy⟩
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    constructor
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩
      exact h₁ y x hxy
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩
      exact h₂ x y hxy

@[simp]
theorem inv_apply {r : Rel α β} {x : α} {y : β} :

theorem inv_injective : Function.Injective (inv : Rel α β → Rel β α) := by
  intro r s h
  ext a b : 2
  exact congr_fun₂ h b a

@[simp]
theorem inv_inj {r s : Rel α β} : r.inv = s.inv ↔ r = s :=
  ⟨λ h ↦ inv_injective h, λ h ↦ h ▸ rfl⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_injective_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Injective ↔ r.Coinjective :=

@[simp]
theorem inv_coinjective_iff {r : Rel α β} :

@[simp]
theorem inv_surjective_iff {r : Rel α β} :

@[simp]
theorem inv_cosurjective_iff {r : Rel α β} :

  inv_surjective_iff.symm

@[simp]
theorem inv_functional_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Functional ↔ r.Cofunctional :=
  ⟨λ h ↦ ⟨inv_coinjective_iff.mp h.toCoinjective, inv_cosurjective_iff.mp h.toCosurjective⟩,
    λ h ↦ ⟨inv_injective_iff.mp h.toInjective, inv_surjective_iff.mp h.toSurjective⟩⟩

theorem inv_cofunctional_iff {r : Rel α β} :

theorem comp_inv {r : Rel α β} {s : Rel β γ} :
    (r.comp s).inv = s.inv.comp r.inv := by
  ext c a
  simp only [inv, flip, comp]
  tauto

theorem Injective.image_injective {r : Rel α β} (h : r.Injective) {s t : Set α}
    (hs : s ⊆ r.dom) (ht : t ⊆ r.dom) (hst : r.image s = r.image t) : s = t := by
  rw [Set.ext_iff] at hst ⊢
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ := hs hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := (hst y).mp ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
    cases h.injective hxy hzy
    exact hz
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ := ht hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := (hst y).mpr ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
    cases h.injective hxy hzy
    exact hz

theorem subset_image_of_preimage_subset {r : Rel α β} {s : Set β} (hs : s ⊆ r.codom) (t : Set α) :
    r.preimage s ⊆ t → s ⊆ r.image t := by
  intro hst y hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hs hy
  exact ⟨x, hst ⟨y, hy, hx⟩, hx⟩

theorem Injective.preimage_subset_of_subset_image {r : Rel α β} (h : r.Injective)
    (s : Set β) (t : Set α) :
    s ⊆ r.image t → r.preimage s ⊆ t := by
  rintro hst x ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := hst hy
  cases h.injective hzy hxy
  exact hz

theorem Injective.preimage_subset_iff_subset_image {r : Rel α β} (h : r.Injective)
    (s : Set β) (hs : s ⊆ r.codom) (t : Set α) :
    r.preimage s ⊆ t ↔ s ⊆ r.image t :=
  ⟨subset_image_of_preimage_subset hs t, preimage_subset_of_subset_image h s t⟩

theorem OneOne.preimage_eq_iff_image_eq {r : Rel α β} (h : r.OneOne)
    {s : Set β} (hs : s ⊆ r.codom) {t : Set α} (ht : t ⊆ r.dom) :
    r.preimage s = t ↔ r.image t = s := by
  have h₁ := h.preimage_subset_iff_subset_image s hs t
  have h₂ := h.inv.preimage_subset_iff_subset_image t ht s
  rw [preimage_inv, inv_image] at h₂
  rw [subset_antisymm_iff, subset_antisymm_iff, h₁, h₂, and_comm]

theorem CodomEqDom.inv {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) : r.inv.CodomEqDom := by
  rw [codomEqDom_iff] at h ⊢

theorem Permutative.inv {r : Rel α α} (h : r.Permutative) : r.inv.Permutative :=
  ⟨h.toOneOne.inv, h.toCodomEqDom.inv⟩

theorem Permutative.inv_dom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.Permutative) : r.inv.dom = r.dom :=

theorem Injective.comp {r : Rel α β} {s : Rel β γ} (hr : r.Injective) (hs : s.Injective) :
    (r.comp s).Injective := by
  constructor
  rintro a₁ a₂ c ⟨b₁, hr₁, hs₁⟩ ⟨b₂, hr₂, hs₂⟩
  cases hs.injective hs₁ hs₂
  exact hr.injective hr₁ hr₂

theorem Coinjective.comp {r : Rel α β} {s : Rel β γ} (hr : r.Coinjective) (hs : s.Coinjective) :
    (r.comp s).Coinjective := by
  rw [← inv_injective_iff, comp_inv]
  exact Injective.comp (inv_injective_iff.mpr hs) (inv_injective_iff.mpr hr)

theorem Injective.mono {r s : Rel α β} (hs : s.Injective) (h : r ≤ s) :
    r.Injective := by
  constructor
  intro a₁ a₂ b h₁ h₂
  exact hs.injective (h a₁ b h₁) (h a₂ b h₂)

theorem Coinjective.mono {r s : Rel α β} (hs : s.Coinjective) (h : r ≤ s) :
    r.Coinjective := by
  constructor
  intro b₁ b₂ a h₁ h₂
  exact hs.coinjective (h a b₁ h₁) (h a b₂ h₂)

theorem OneOne.mono {r s : Rel α β} (hs : s.OneOne) (h : r ≤ s) :

  ⟨hs.toInjective.mono h, hs.toCoinjective.mono h⟩

  r.uncurry

theorem le_of_graph'_subset {r s : Rel α β} (h : r.graph' ⊆ s.graph') :
    r ≤ s :=
  λ x y h' ↦ mem_of_subset_of_mem (a := (x, y)) h h'

theorem graph'_subset_of_le {r s : Rel α β} (h : r ≤ s) :
    r.graph' ⊆ s.graph' :=
  λ z ↦ h z.1 z.2

theorem graph'_subset_iff {r s : Rel α β} :
    r.graph' ⊆ s.graph' ↔ r ≤ s :=
  ⟨le_of_graph'_subset, graph'_subset_of_le⟩

theorem graph'_injective :
    Function.Injective (Rel.graph' : Rel α β → Set (α × β)) :=
  λ _ _ h ↦ le_antisymm (le_of_graph'_subset h.le) (le_of_graph'_subset h.symm.le)

theorem image_subset_codom (r : Rel α β) (s : Set α) :

theorem image_empty_of_disjoint_dom {r : Rel α β} {s : Set α} (h : Disjoint r.dom s) :
    r.image s = ∅ := by
  rw [eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
  rw [disjoint_iff_forall_ne] at h
  rintro y ⟨x, hx₁, hx₂⟩
  exact h ⟨y, hx₂⟩ hx₁ rfl

theorem image_eq_of_inter_eq {r : Rel α β} {s t : Set α} (h : s ∩ r.dom = t ∩ r.dom) :
    r.image s = r.image t := by
  rw [Set.ext_iff] at h ⊢
  intro b
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, has, hab⟩
    obtain ⟨hat, _⟩ := (h a).mp ⟨has, b, hab⟩
    exact ⟨a, hat, hab⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, hat, hab⟩
    obtain ⟨has, _⟩ := (h a).mpr ⟨hat, b, hab⟩
    exact ⟨a, has, hab⟩

theorem Injective.image_diff {r : Rel α β} (h : r.Injective) (s t : Set α) :
    r.image (s \ t) = r.image s \ r.image t := by

import Mathlib.Data.Rel
import Mathlib.Order.Chain

open Set
open scoped symmDiff

namespace Rel

variable {α β γ : Type _}

def field (r : Rel α α) : Set α :=
  r.dom ∪ r.codom

@[mk_iff]
structure Injective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  injective : ∀ ⦃x₁ x₂ y⦄, r x₁ y → r x₂ y → x₁ = x₂

@[mk_iff]
structure Coinjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  coinjective : ∀ ⦃y₁ y₂ x⦄, r x y₁ → r x y₂ → y₁ = y₂

@[mk_iff]
structure Surjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  surjective : ∀ y, ∃ x, r x y

@[mk_iff]
structure Cosurjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  cosurjective : ∀ x, ∃ y, r x y

@[mk_iff]
structure Functional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Coinjective, r.Cosurjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure Cofunctional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Injective, r.Surjective : Prop

import Mathlib.Data.Rel

open Set
open scoped symmDiff

namespace Rel

variable {α β γ : Type _}

def field (r : Rel α α) : Set α :=
  r.dom ∪ r.codom

@[mk_iff]
structure Injective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  injective : ∀ ⦃x₁ x₂ y⦄, r x₁ y → r x₂ y → x₁ = x₂

@[mk_iff]
structure Coinjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  coinjective : ∀ ⦃y₁ y₂ x⦄, r x y₁ → r x y₂ → y₁ = y₂

@[mk_iff]
structure Surjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  surjective : ∀ y, ∃ x, r x y

@[mk_iff]
structure Cosurjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  cosurjective : ∀ x, ∃ y, r x y

@[mk_iff]
structure Functional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Coinjective, r.Cosurjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure Cofunctional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Injective, r.Surjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure OneOne (r : Rel α β) extends r.Injective, r.Coinjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure Bijective (r : Rel α β) extends r.Functional, r.Cofunctional : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure CodomEqDom (r : Rel α α) : Prop where
  codom_eq_dom : r.codom = r.dom

@[mk_iff]
structure Permutative (r : Rel α α) extends r.OneOne, r.CodomEqDom : Prop

theorem CodomEqDom.dom_union_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) :
    r.dom ∪ r.codom = r.dom := by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom, union_self]

theorem CodomEqDom.mem_dom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) {x y : α} (hxy : r x y) :
    y ∈ r.dom := by
  rw [← h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨x, hxy⟩

theorem CodomEqDom.mem_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) {x y : α} (hxy : r x y) :
    x ∈ r.codom := by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨y, hxy⟩

/-- An elementary description of the property `CodomEqDom`. -/
theorem codomEqDom_iff' (r : Rel α α) :
    r.CodomEqDom ↔ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r y z) ∧ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r z x) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h⟩
    rw [Set.ext_iff] at h
    constructor
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h y).mp ⟨x, hxy⟩
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h x).mpr ⟨y, hxy⟩
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    constructor
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩
      exact h₁ y x hxy
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩
      exact h₂ x y hxy

theorem OneOne.inv {r : Rel α β} (h : r.OneOne) : r.inv.OneOne :=
  ⟨⟨h.coinjective⟩, ⟨h.injective⟩⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_apply {r : Rel α β} {x : α} {y : β} :
    r.inv y x ↔ r x y :=
  Iff.rfl

theorem inv_injective : Function.Injective (inv : Rel α β → Rel β α) := by
  intro r s h
  ext a b : 2
  exact congr_fun₂ h b a

@[simp]
theorem inv_inj {r s : Rel α β} : r.inv = s.inv ↔ r = s :=
  ⟨λ h ↦ inv_injective h, λ h ↦ h ▸ rfl⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_injective_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Injective ↔ r.Coinjective :=
  ⟨λ h ↦ ⟨h.injective⟩, λ h ↦ ⟨h.coinjective⟩⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_coinjective_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Coinjective ↔ r.Injective :=
  inv_injective_iff.symm

@[simp]
theorem inv_surjective_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Surjective ↔ r.Cosurjective :=
  ⟨λ h ↦ ⟨h.surjective⟩, λ h ↦ ⟨h.cosurjective⟩⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_cosurjective_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Cosurjective ↔ r.Surjective :=
  inv_surjective_iff.symm

@[simp]
theorem inv_functional_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Functional ↔ r.Cofunctional :=
  ⟨λ h ↦ ⟨inv_coinjective_iff.mp h.toCoinjective, inv_cosurjective_iff.mp h.toCosurjective⟩,
    λ h ↦ ⟨inv_injective_iff.mp h.toInjective, inv_surjective_iff.mp h.toSurjective⟩⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_cofunctional_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Cofunctional ↔ r.Functional :=
  inv_functional_iff.symm

@[simp]
theorem inv_codom {r : Rel α β} :

theorem comp_inv {r : Rel α β} {s : Rel β γ} :
    (r.comp s).inv = s.inv.comp r.inv := by
  ext c a
  simp only [inv, flip, comp]
  tauto

theorem Injective.image_injective {r : Rel α β} (h : r.Injective) {s t : Set α}
    (hs : s ⊆ r.dom) (ht : t ⊆ r.dom) (hst : r.image s = r.image t) : s = t := by
  rw [Set.ext_iff] at hst ⊢
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ := hs hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := (hst y).mp ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
    cases h.injective hxy hzy
    exact hz
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ := ht hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := (hst y).mpr ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
    cases h.injective hxy hzy
    exact hz

theorem subset_image_of_preimage_subset {r : Rel α β} {s : Set β} (hs : s ⊆ r.codom) (t : Set α) :
    r.preimage s ⊆ t → s ⊆ r.image t := by
  intro hst y hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hs hy
  exact ⟨x, hst ⟨y, hy, hx⟩, hx⟩

theorem Injective.preimage_subset_of_subset_image {r : Rel α β} (h : r.Injective)
    (s : Set β) (t : Set α) :
    s ⊆ r.image t → r.preimage s ⊆ t := by
  rintro hst x ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := hst hy
  cases h.injective hzy hxy
  exact hz

    (s : Set β) (hs : s ⊆ r.codom) (t : Set α) :
    r.preimage s ⊆ t ↔ s ⊆ r.image t :=

    {s : Set β} (hs : s ⊆ r.codom) {t : Set α} (ht : t ⊆ r.dom) :
    r.preimage s = t ↔ r.image t = s := by
  have h₁ := h.preimage_subset_iff_subset_image s hs t
  have h₂ := h.inv.preimage_subset_iff_subset_image t ht s
  rw [preimage_inv, inv_image] at h₂
  rw [subset_antisymm_iff, subset_antisymm_iff, h₁, h₂, and_comm]

namespace Rel

variable {α β γ : Type _}

def field (r : Rel α α) : Set α :=
  r.dom ∪ r.codom

@[mk_iff]
structure Injective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  injective : ∀ ⦃x₁ x₂ y⦄, r x₁ y → r x₂ y → x₁ = x₂

@[mk_iff]
structure Coinjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  coinjective : ∀ ⦃y₁ y₂ x⦄, r x y₁ → r x y₂ → y₁ = y₂

@[mk_iff]
structure Surjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  surjective : ∀ y, ∃ x, r x y

@[mk_iff]
structure Cosurjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  cosurjective : ∀ x, ∃ y, r x y

@[mk_iff]
structure Functional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Coinjective, r.Cosurjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure Cofunctional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Injective, r.Surjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure OneOne (r : Rel α β) extends r.Injective, r.Coinjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure Bijective (r : Rel α β) extends r.Functional, r.Cofunctional : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure CodomEqDom (r : Rel α α) : Prop where
  codom_eq_dom : r.codom = r.dom

@[mk_iff]
structure Permutative (r : Rel α α) extends r.OneOne, r.CodomEqDom : Prop

theorem CodomEqDom.dom_union_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) :
    r.dom ∪ r.codom = r.dom := by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom, union_self]

theorem CodomEqDom.mem_dom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) {x y : α} (hxy : r x y) :
    y ∈ r.dom := by
  rw [← h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨x, hxy⟩

theorem CodomEqDom.mem_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) {x y : α} (hxy : r x y) :
    x ∈ r.codom := by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨y, hxy⟩

/-- An elementary description of the property `CodomEqDom`. -/
theorem codomEqDom_iff' (r : Rel α α) :
    r.CodomEqDom ↔ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r y z) ∧ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r z x) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h⟩
    rw [Set.ext_iff] at h
    constructor
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h y).mp ⟨x, hxy⟩
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h x).mpr ⟨y, hxy⟩
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    constructor
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩
      exact h₁ y x hxy
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩
      exact h₂ x y hxy

theorem OneOne.inv {r : Rel α β} (h : r.OneOne) : r.inv.OneOne :=
  ⟨⟨h.coinjective⟩, ⟨h.injective⟩⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_apply {r : Rel α β} {x : α} {y : β} :
    r.inv y x ↔ r x y :=
  Iff.rfl

theorem inv_injective : Function.Injective (inv : Rel α β → Rel β α) := by
  intro r s h
  ext a b : 2
  exact congr_fun₂ h b a

@[simp]
theorem inv_inj {r s : Rel α β} : r.inv = s.inv ↔ r = s :=
  ⟨λ h ↦ inv_injective h, λ h ↦ h ▸ rfl⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_injective_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Injective ↔ r.Coinjective :=
  ⟨λ h ↦ ⟨h.injective⟩, λ h ↦ ⟨h.coinjective⟩⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_coinjective_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Coinjective ↔ r.Injective :=
  inv_injective_iff.symm

@[simp]
theorem inv_surjective_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Surjective ↔ r.Cosurjective :=
  ⟨λ h ↦ ⟨h.surjective⟩, λ h ↦ ⟨h.cosurjective⟩⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_cosurjective_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Cosurjective ↔ r.Surjective :=
  inv_surjective_iff.symm

@[simp]
theorem inv_functional_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Functional ↔ r.Cofunctional :=
  ⟨λ h ↦ ⟨inv_coinjective_iff.mp h.toCoinjective, inv_cosurjective_iff.mp h.toCosurjective⟩,
    λ h ↦ ⟨inv_injective_iff.mp h.toInjective, inv_surjective_iff.mp h.toSurjective⟩⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_cofunctional_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Cofunctional ↔ r.Functional :=
  inv_functional_iff.symm

@[simp]
theorem inv_dom {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.dom = r.codom :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem inv_codom {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.codom = r.dom :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem inv_image {r : Rel α β} {s : Set β} :
    r.inv.image s = r.preimage s :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem inv_preimage {r : Rel α β} {s : Set α} :
    r.inv.preimage s = r.image s :=
  rfl

theorem comp_inv {r : Rel α β} {s : Rel β γ} :
    (r.comp s).inv = s.inv.comp r.inv := by
  ext c a
  simp only [inv, flip, comp]
  tauto

theorem Injective.image_injective {r : Rel α β} (h : r.Injective) {s t : Set α}
    (hs : s ⊆ r.dom) (ht : t ⊆ r.dom) (hst : r.image s = r.image t) : s = t := by
  rw [Set.ext_iff] at hst ⊢
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ := hs hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := (hst y).mp ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
    cases h.injective hxy hzy
    exact hz
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ := ht hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := (hst y).mpr ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
    cases h.injective hxy hzy
    exact hz

theorem subset_image_of_preimage_subset {r : Rel α β} {s : Set β} (hs : s ⊆ r.codom) (t : Set α) :
    r.preimage s ⊆ t → s ⊆ r.image t := by
  intro hst y hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hs hy
  exact ⟨x, hst ⟨y, hy, hx⟩, hx⟩

theorem Injective.preimage_subset_of_subset_image {r : Rel α β} (h : r.Injective)
    (s : Set β) (t : Set α) :
    s ⊆ r.image t → r.preimage s ⊆ t := by
  rintro hst x ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := hst hy
  cases h.injective hzy hxy
  exact hz

theorem Injective.preimage_subset_iff_subset_image {r : Rel α β} (h : r.Injective)
    (s : Set β) (hs : s ⊆ r.codom) (t : Set α) :
    r.preimage s ⊆ t ↔ s ⊆ r.image t :=
  ⟨subset_image_of_preimage_subset hs t, preimage_subset_of_subset_image h s t⟩

theorem OneOne.preimage_eq_iff_image_eq {r : Rel α β} (h : r.OneOne)
    {s : Set β} (hs : s ⊆ r.codom) {t : Set α} (ht : t ⊆ r.dom) :
    r.preimage s = t ↔ r.image t = s := by
  have h₁ := h.preimage_subset_iff_subset_image s hs t
  have h₂ := h.inv.preimage_subset_iff_subset_image t ht s
  rw [preimage_inv, inv_image] at h₂
  rw [subset_antisymm_iff, subset_antisymm_iff, h₁, h₂, and_comm]

theorem CodomEqDom.inv {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) : r.inv.CodomEqDom := by
  rw [codomEqDom_iff] at h ⊢
  exact h.symm

theorem Permutative.inv {r : Rel α α} (h : r.Permutative) : r.inv.Permutative :=
  ⟨h.toOneOne.inv, h.toCodomEqDom.inv⟩

theorem Permutative.inv_dom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.Permutative) : r.inv.dom = r.dom :=
  h.codom_eq_dom

theorem Injective.comp {r : Rel α β} {s : Rel β γ} (hr : r.Injective) (hs : s.Injective) :
    (r.comp s).Injective := by
  constructor
  rintro a₁ a₂ c ⟨b₁, hr₁, hs₁⟩ ⟨b₂, hr₂, hs₂⟩
  cases hs.injective hs₁ hs₂
  exact hr.injective hr₁ hr₂

theorem Coinjective.comp {r : Rel α β} {s : Rel β γ} (hr : r.Coinjective) (hs : s.Coinjective) :
    (r.comp s).Coinjective := by
  rw [← inv_injective_iff, comp_inv]
  exact Injective.comp (inv_injective_iff.mpr hs) (inv_injective_iff.mpr hr)

theorem Injective.mono {r s : Rel α β} (hs : s.Injective) (h : r ≤ s) :
    r.Injective := by
  constructor
  intro a₁ a₂ b h₁ h₂
  exact hs.injective (h a₁ b h₁) (h a₂ b h₂)

theorem Coinjective.mono {r s : Rel α β} (hs : s.Coinjective) (h : r ≤ s) :
    r.Coinjective := by
  constructor
  intro b₁ b₂ a h₁ h₂
  exact hs.coinjective (h a b₁ h₁) (h a b₂ h₂)

theorem OneOne.mono {r s : Rel α β} (hs : s.OneOne) (h : r ≤ s) :
    r.OneOne :=
  ⟨hs.toInjective.mono h, hs.toCoinjective.mono h⟩

/-- An alternative spelling of `Rel.graph` that is useful for proving inequalities of cardinals. -/
def graph' (r : Rel α β) : Set (α × β) :=
  r.uncurry

theorem le_of_graph'_subset {r s : Rel α β} (h : r.graph' ⊆ s.graph') :
    r ≤ s :=
  λ x y h' ↦ mem_of_subset_of_mem (a := (x, y)) h h'

theorem graph'_subset_of_le {r s : Rel α β} (h : r ≤ s) :
    r.graph' ⊆ s.graph' :=
  λ z ↦ h z.1 z.2

theorem graph'_subset_iff {r s : Rel α β} :
    r.graph' ⊆ s.graph' ↔ r ≤ s :=
  ⟨le_of_graph'_subset, graph'_subset_of_le⟩

theorem graph'_injective :
    Function.Injective (Rel.graph' : Rel α β → Set (α × β)) :=
  λ _ _ h ↦ le_antisymm (le_of_graph'_subset h.le) (le_of_graph'_subset h.symm.le)

@[simp]
theorem image_dom {r : Rel α β} :
    r.image r.dom = r.codom :=
  preimage_eq_codom_of_domain_subset r subset_rfl

@[simp]
theorem preimage_codom {r : Rel α β} :
    r.preimage r.codom = r.dom :=
  image_dom

theorem preimage_subset_dom (r : Rel α β) (t : Set β) :
    r.preimage t ⊆ r.dom := by
  rintro x ⟨y, _, h⟩
  exact ⟨y, h⟩

theorem image_subset_codom (r : Rel α β) (s : Set α) :
    r.image s ⊆ r.codom :=
  r.inv.preimage_subset_dom s

theorem image_empty_of_disjoint_dom {r : Rel α β} {s : Set α} (h : Disjoint r.dom s) :
    r.image s = ∅ := by
  rw [eq_empty_iff_forall_not_mem]
  rw [disjoint_iff_forall_ne] at h
  rintro y ⟨x, hx₁, hx₂⟩
  exact h ⟨y, hx₂⟩ hx₁ rfl

theorem image_eq_of_inter_eq {r : Rel α β} {s t : Set α} (h : s ∩ r.dom = t ∩ r.dom) :
    r.image s = r.image t := by
  rw [Set.ext_iff] at h ⊢
  intro b
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, has, hab⟩
    obtain ⟨hat, _⟩ := (h a).mp ⟨has, b, hab⟩
    exact ⟨a, hat, hab⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, hat, hab⟩
    obtain ⟨has, _⟩ := (h a).mpr ⟨hat, b, hab⟩
    exact ⟨a, has, hab⟩

/-- A set is a collection of elements of some type `α`.

Although `Set` is defined as `α → Prop`, this is an implementation detail which should not be
relied on. Instead, `setOf` and membership of a set (`∈`) should be used to convert between sets
and predicates.
-/
def Set (α : Type u) := α → Prop

import Mathlib.Data.Rel
import Mathlib.Order.Chain

open Set
open scoped symmDiff

namespace Rel

variable {α β γ : Type _}

def field (r : Rel α α) : Set α :=
  r.dom ∪ r.codom

@[mk_iff]
structure Injective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  injective : ∀ ⦃x₁ x₂ y⦄, r x₁ y → r x₂ y → x₁ = x₂

@[mk_iff]
structure Coinjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  coinjective : ∀ ⦃y₁ y₂ x⦄, r x y₁ → r x y₂ → y₁ = y₂

@[mk_iff]
structure Surjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  surjective : ∀ y, ∃ x, r x y

@[mk_iff]
structure Cosurjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  cosurjective : ∀ x, ∃ y, r x y

@[mk_iff]
structure Functional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Coinjective, r.Cosurjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure Cofunctional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Injective, r.Surjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure OneOne (r : Rel α β) extends r.Injective, r.Coinjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure Bijective (r : Rel α β) extends r.Functional, r.Cofunctional : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure CodomEqDom (r : Rel α α) : Prop where
  codom_eq_dom : r.codom = r.dom

@[mk_iff]
structure Permutative (r : Rel α α) extends r.OneOne, r.CodomEqDom : Prop

theorem CodomEqDom.dom_union_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) :
    r.dom ∪ r.codom = r.dom := by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom, union_self]

theorem CodomEqDom.mem_dom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) {x y : α} (hxy : r x y) :
    y ∈ r.dom := by
  rw [← h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨x, hxy⟩

theorem CodomEqDom.mem_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) {x y : α} (hxy : r x y) :
    x ∈ r.codom := by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨y, hxy⟩

/-- An elementary description of the property `CodomEqDom`. -/
theorem codomEqDom_iff' (r : Rel α α) :
    r.CodomEqDom ↔ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r y z) ∧ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r z x) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h⟩
    rw [Set.ext_iff] at h
    constructor
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h y).mp ⟨x, hxy⟩
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h x).mpr ⟨y, hxy⟩
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    constructor
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩
      exact h₁ y x hxy
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩
      exact h₂ x y hxy

theorem OneOne.inv {r : Rel α β} (h : r.OneOne) : r.inv.OneOne :=
  ⟨⟨h.coinjective⟩, ⟨h.injective⟩⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_apply {r : Rel α β} {x : α} {y : β} :
    r.inv y x ↔ r x y :=
  Iff.rfl

theorem inv_injective : Function.Injective (inv : Rel α β → Rel β α) := by
  intro r s h
  ext a b : 2
  exact congr_fun₂ h b a

C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

C1_dependencies.name: Disjoint
C1_dependencies.content:
/-- Two elements of a lattice are disjoint if their inf is the bottom element.
  (This generalizes disjoint sets, viewed as members of the subset lattice.)

Note that we define this without reference to `⊓`, as this allows us to talk about orders where
the infimum is not unique, or where implementing `Inf` would require additional `Decidable`
arguments. -/
def Disjoint (a b : α) : Prop :=
  ∀ ⦃x⦄, x ≤ a → x ≤ b → x ≤ ⊥

Although `Set` is defined as `α → Prop`, this is an implementation detail which should not be

theorem graph'_subset_of_le {r s : Rel α β} (h : r ≤ s) :
    r.graph' ⊆ s.graph' :=

open scoped symmDiff

namespace Rel

variable {α β γ : Type _}

def field (r : Rel α α) : Set α :=
  r.dom ∪ r.codom

structure Injective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  injective : ∀ ⦃x₁ x₂ y⦄, r x₁ y → r x₂ y → x₁ = x₂

@[mk_iff]
structure Coinjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  coinjective : ∀ ⦃y₁ y₂ x⦄, r x y₁ → r x y₂ → y₁ = y₂

@[mk_iff]
structure Surjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  surjective : ∀ y, ∃ x, r x y

@[mk_iff]
structure Cosurjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  cosurjective : ∀ x, ∃ y, r x y

@[mk_iff]
structure Functional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Coinjective, r.Cosurjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure Cofunctional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Injective, r.Surjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure OneOne (r : Rel α β) extends r.Injective, r.Coinjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure Bijective (r : Rel α β) extends r.Functional, r.Cofunctional : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure CodomEqDom (r : Rel α α) : Prop where
  codom_eq_dom : r.codom = r.dom

@[mk_iff]
structure Permutative (r : Rel α α) extends r.OneOne, r.CodomEqDom : Prop

theorem CodomEqDom.dom_union_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) :
    r.dom ∪ r.codom = r.dom := by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom, union_self]

theorem CodomEqDom.mem_dom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) {x y : α} (hxy : r x y) :
    y ∈ r.dom := by
  rw [← h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨x, hxy⟩

theorem CodomEqDom.mem_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) {x y : α} (hxy : r x y) :
    x ∈ r.codom := by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨y, hxy⟩

/-- An elementary description of the property `CodomEqDom`. -/
theorem codomEqDom_iff' (r : Rel α α) :
    r.CodomEqDom ↔ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r y z) ∧ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r z x) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h⟩
    rw [Set.ext_iff] at h
    constructor
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h y).mp ⟨x, hxy⟩
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h x).mpr ⟨y, hxy⟩
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    constructor
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩
      exact h₁ y x hxy
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩
      exact h₂ x y hxy

    r.inv y x ↔ r x y :=

theorem inv_injective : Function.Injective (inv : Rel α β → Rel β α) := by

  exact congr_fun₂ h b a

    r.inv.Cosurjective ↔ r.Surjective :=
  inv_surjective_iff.symm

  ⟨λ h ↦ ⟨inv_coinjective_iff.mp h.toCoinjective, inv_cosurjective_iff.mp h.toCosurjective⟩,
    λ h ↦ ⟨inv_injective_iff.mp h.toInjective, inv_surjective_iff.mp h.toSurjective⟩⟩

theorem inv_cofunctional_iff {r : Rel α β} :

@[simp]
theorem inv_codom {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.codom = r.dom :=

@[simp]

    r.inv.preimage s = r.image s :=

    (r.comp s).inv = s.inv.comp r.inv := by
  ext c a
  simp only [inv, flip, comp]
  tauto

theorem Injective.image_injective {r : Rel α β} (h : r.Injective) {s t : Set α}
    (hs : s ⊆ r.dom) (ht : t ⊆ r.dom) (hst : r.image s = r.image t) : s = t := by
  rw [Set.ext_iff] at hst ⊢
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ := hs hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := (hst y).mp ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
    cases h.injective hxy hzy
    exact hz
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ := ht hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := (hst y).mpr ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
    cases h.injective hxy hzy
    exact hz

theorem subset_image_of_preimage_subset {r : Rel α β} {s : Set β} (hs : s ⊆ r.codom) (t : Set α) :
    r.preimage s ⊆ t → s ⊆ r.image t := by
  intro hst y hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hs hy
  exact ⟨x, hst ⟨y, hy, hx⟩, hx⟩

theorem Injective.preimage_subset_of_subset_image {r : Rel α β} (h : r.Injective)
    (s : Set β) (t : Set α) :
    s ⊆ r.image t → r.preimage s ⊆ t := by
  rintro hst x ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := hst hy
  cases h.injective hzy hxy
  exact hz

theorem Injective.preimage_subset_iff_subset_image {r : Rel α β} (h : r.Injective)
    (s : Set β) (hs : s ⊆ r.codom) (t : Set α) :
    r.preimage s ⊆ t ↔ s ⊆ r.image t :=
  ⟨subset_image_of_preimage_subset hs t, preimage_subset_of_subset_image h s t⟩

theorem OneOne.preimage_eq_iff_image_eq {r : Rel α β} (h : r.OneOne)
    {s : Set β} (hs : s ⊆ r.codom) {t : Set α} (ht : t ⊆ r.dom) :
    r.preimage s = t ↔ r.image t = s := by
  have h₁ := h.preimage_subset_iff_subset_image s hs t
  have h₂ := h.inv.preimage_subset_iff_subset_image t ht s
  rw [preimage_inv, inv_image] at h₂
  rw [subset_antisymm_iff, subset_antisymm_iff, h₁, h₂, and_comm]

theorem CodomEqDom.inv {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) : r.inv.CodomEqDom := by
  rw [codomEqDom_iff] at h ⊢
  exact h.symm

theorem Permutative.inv {r : Rel α α} (h : r.Permutative) : r.inv.Permutative :=
  ⟨h.toOneOne.inv, h.toCodomEqDom.inv⟩

theorem Permutative.inv_dom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.Permutative) : r.inv.dom = r.dom :=
  h.codom_eq_dom

theorem Injective.comp {r : Rel α β} {s : Rel β γ} (hr : r.Injective) (hs : s.Injective) :
    (r.comp s).Injective := by
  constructor
  rintro a₁ a₂ c ⟨b₁, hr₁, hs₁⟩ ⟨b₂, hr₂, hs₂⟩
  cases hs.injective hs₁ hs₂
  exact hr.injective hr₁ hr₂

theorem Coinjective.comp {r : Rel α β} {s : Rel β γ} (hr : r.Coinjective) (hs : s.Coinjective) :
    (r.comp s).Coinjective := by
  rw [← inv_injective_iff, comp_inv]
  exact Injective.comp (inv_injective_iff.mpr hs) (inv_injective_iff.mpr hr)

    r.Injective := by
  constructor
  intro a₁ a₂ b h₁ h₂
  exact hs.injective (h a₁ b h₁) (h a₂ b h₂)

  exact hs.coinjective (h a b₁ h₁) (h a b₂ h₂)

    r.graph' ⊆ s.graph' :=

structure Surjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  surjective : ∀ y, ∃ x, r x y

@[mk_iff]

@[mk_iff]
structure Cofunctional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Injective, r.Surjective : Prop

  codom_eq_dom : r.codom = r.dom

structure Permutative (r : Rel α α) extends r.OneOne, r.CodomEqDom : Prop

theorem CodomEqDom.dom_union_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) :
    r.dom ∪ r.codom = r.dom := by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom, union_self]

    y ∈ r.dom := by
  rw [← h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨x, hxy⟩

theorem CodomEqDom.mem_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) {x y : α} (hxy : r x y) :
    x ∈ r.codom := by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨y, hxy⟩

theorem codomEqDom_iff' (r : Rel α α) :
    r.CodomEqDom ↔ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r y z) ∧ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r z x) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h⟩
    rw [Set.ext_iff] at h
    constructor
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h y).mp ⟨x, hxy⟩
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h x).mpr ⟨y, hxy⟩
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    constructor
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩

    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩

  rw [Set.ext_iff] at hst ⊢
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ := hs hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := (hst y).mp ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
    cases h.injective hxy hzy
    exact hz
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ := ht hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := (hst y).mpr ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
    cases h.injective hxy hzy

  intro hst y hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hs hy
  exact ⟨x, hst ⟨y, hy, hx⟩, hx⟩

  rintro hst x ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := hst hy
  cases h.injective hzy hxy
  exact hz

    (s : Set β) (hs : s ⊆ r.codom) (t : Set α) :
    r.preimage s ⊆ t ↔ s ⊆ r.image t :=
  ⟨subset_image_of_preimage_subset hs t, preimage_subset_of_subset_image h s t⟩

  have h₁ := h.preimage_subset_iff_subset_image s hs t
  have h₂ := h.inv.preimage_subset_iff_subset_image t ht s
  rw [preimage_inv, inv_image] at h₂
  rw [subset_antisymm_iff, subset_antisymm_iff, h₁, h₂, and_comm]

  rw [codomEqDom_iff] at h ⊢

theorem Permutative.inv_dom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.Permutative) : r.inv.dom = r.dom :=

  rw [← inv_injective_iff, comp_inv]

open Set
open scoped symmDiff

namespace Rel

variable {α β γ : Type _}

def field (r : Rel α α) : Set α :=
  r.dom ∪ r.codom

structure Injective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  injective : ∀ ⦃x₁ x₂ y⦄, r x₁ y → r x₂ y → x₁ = x₂

@[mk_iff]
structure Coinjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  coinjective : ∀ ⦃y₁ y₂ x⦄, r x y₁ → r x y₂ → y₁ = y₂

@[mk_iff]
structure Surjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  surjective : ∀ y, ∃ x, r x y

@[mk_iff]
structure Cosurjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  cosurjective : ∀ x, ∃ y, r x y

@[mk_iff]
structure Functional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Coinjective, r.Cosurjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure Cofunctional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Injective, r.Surjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure OneOne (r : Rel α β) extends r.Injective, r.Coinjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure Bijective (r : Rel α β) extends r.Functional, r.Cofunctional : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure CodomEqDom (r : Rel α α) : Prop where
  codom_eq_dom : r.codom = r.dom

@[mk_iff]
structure Permutative (r : Rel α α) extends r.OneOne, r.CodomEqDom : Prop

theorem CodomEqDom.dom_union_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) :
    r.dom ∪ r.codom = r.dom := by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom, union_self]

theorem CodomEqDom.mem_dom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) {x y : α} (hxy : r x y) :
    y ∈ r.dom := by
  rw [← h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨x, hxy⟩

theorem CodomEqDom.mem_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) {x y : α} (hxy : r x y) :
    x ∈ r.codom := by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨y, hxy⟩

/-- An elementary description of the property `CodomEqDom`. -/
theorem codomEqDom_iff' (r : Rel α α) :
    r.CodomEqDom ↔ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r y z) ∧ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r z x) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h⟩
    rw [Set.ext_iff] at h
    constructor
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h y).mp ⟨x, hxy⟩
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h x).mpr ⟨y, hxy⟩
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    constructor
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩
      exact h₁ y x hxy
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩
      exact h₂ x y hxy

@[simp]

    r.inv y x ↔ r x y :=
  Iff.rfl

theorem inv_injective : Function.Injective (inv : Rel α β → Rel β α) := by
  intro r s h
  ext a b : 2
  exact congr_fun₂ h b a

theorem inv_inj {r s : Rel α β} : r.inv = s.inv ↔ r = s :=

@[simp]

@[simp]
theorem inv_cosurjective_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Cosurjective ↔ r.Surjective :=
  inv_surjective_iff.symm

@[simp]
theorem inv_functional_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Functional ↔ r.Cofunctional :=
  ⟨λ h ↦ ⟨inv_coinjective_iff.mp h.toCoinjective, inv_cosurjective_iff.mp h.toCosurjective⟩,

@[simp]
theorem inv_codom {r : Rel α β} :

@[simp]

theorem comp_inv {r : Rel α β} {s : Rel β γ} :

  ext c a

  tauto

    (hs : s ⊆ r.dom) (ht : t ⊆ r.dom) (hst : r.image s = r.image t) : s = t := by
  rw [Set.ext_iff] at hst ⊢
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ := hs hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := (hst y).mp ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
    cases h.injective hxy hzy
    exact hz
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ := ht hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := (hst y).mpr ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
    cases h.injective hxy hzy
    exact hz

theorem subset_image_of_preimage_subset {r : Rel α β} {s : Set β} (hs : s ⊆ r.codom) (t : Set α) :
    r.preimage s ⊆ t → s ⊆ r.image t := by
  intro hst y hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hs hy
  exact ⟨x, hst ⟨y, hy, hx⟩, hx⟩

theorem Injective.preimage_subset_of_subset_image {r : Rel α β} (h : r.Injective)
    (s : Set β) (t : Set α) :

  rintro hst x ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := hst hy
  cases h.injective hzy hxy
  exact hz

theorem Injective.preimage_subset_iff_subset_image {r : Rel α β} (h : r.Injective)
    (s : Set β) (hs : s ⊆ r.codom) (t : Set α) :
    r.preimage s ⊆ t ↔ s ⊆ r.image t :=
  ⟨subset_image_of_preimage_subset hs t, preimage_subset_of_subset_image h s t⟩

theorem OneOne.preimage_eq_iff_image_eq {r : Rel α β} (h : r.OneOne)
    {s : Set β} (hs : s ⊆ r.codom) {t : Set α} (ht : t ⊆ r.dom) :
    r.preimage s = t ↔ r.image t = s := by
  have h₁ := h.preimage_subset_iff_subset_image s hs t
  have h₂ := h.inv.preimage_subset_iff_subset_image t ht s
  rw [preimage_inv, inv_image] at h₂
  rw [subset_antisymm_iff, subset_antisymm_iff, h₁, h₂, and_comm]

theorem CodomEqDom.inv {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) : r.inv.CodomEqDom := by
  rw [codomEqDom_iff] at h ⊢
  exact h.symm

theorem Permutative.inv {r : Rel α α} (h : r.Permutative) : r.inv.Permutative :=
  ⟨h.toOneOne.inv, h.toCodomEqDom.inv⟩

theorem Permutative.inv_dom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.Permutative) : r.inv.dom = r.dom :=
  h.codom_eq_dom

theorem Injective.comp {r : Rel α β} {s : Rel β γ} (hr : r.Injective) (hs : s.Injective) :
    (r.comp s).Injective := by
  constructor
  rintro a₁ a₂ c ⟨b₁, hr₁, hs₁⟩ ⟨b₂, hr₂, hs₂⟩
  cases hs.injective hs₁ hs₂
  exact hr.injective hr₁ hr₂

theorem Coinjective.comp {r : Rel α β} {s : Rel β γ} (hr : r.Coinjective) (hs : s.Coinjective) :
    (r.comp s).Coinjective := by
  rw [← inv_injective_iff, comp_inv]
  exact Injective.comp (inv_injective_iff.mpr hs) (inv_injective_iff.mpr hr)

    r.graph' ⊆ s.graph' :=

    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := (hst y).mp ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩

import Mathlib.Data.Rel

open Set
open scoped symmDiff

namespace Rel

variable {α β γ : Type _}

def field (r : Rel α α) : Set α :=
  r.dom ∪ r.codom

@[mk_iff]
structure Injective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  injective : ∀ ⦃x₁ x₂ y⦄, r x₁ y → r x₂ y → x₁ = x₂

@[mk_iff]
structure Coinjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  coinjective : ∀ ⦃y₁ y₂ x⦄, r x y₁ → r x y₂ → y₁ = y₂

@[mk_iff]
structure Surjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  surjective : ∀ y, ∃ x, r x y

@[mk_iff]
structure Cosurjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  cosurjective : ∀ x, ∃ y, r x y

@[mk_iff]
structure Functional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Coinjective, r.Cosurjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure Cofunctional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Injective, r.Surjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure OneOne (r : Rel α β) extends r.Injective, r.Coinjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure Bijective (r : Rel α β) extends r.Functional, r.Cofunctional : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure CodomEqDom (r : Rel α α) : Prop where

  rintro hst x ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩

  cases h.injective hzy hxy

  surjective : ∀ y, ∃ x, r x y

theorem comp_inv {r : Rel α β} {s : Rel β γ} :

  ext c a
  simp only [inv, flip, comp]
  tauto

theorem Injective.image_injective {r : Rel α β} (h : r.Injective) {s t : Set α}
    (hs : s ⊆ r.dom) (ht : t ⊆ r.dom) (hst : r.image s = r.image t) : s = t := by
  rw [Set.ext_iff] at hst ⊢
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ := hs hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := (hst y).mp ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
    cases h.injective hxy hzy
    exact hz
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ := ht hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := (hst y).mpr ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
    cases h.injective hxy hzy
    exact hz

theorem subset_image_of_preimage_subset {r : Rel α β} {s : Set β} (hs : s ⊆ r.codom) (t : Set α) :
    r.preimage s ⊆ t → s ⊆ r.image t := by
  intro hst y hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hs hy
  exact ⟨x, hst ⟨y, hy, hx⟩, hx⟩

theorem Injective.preimage_subset_of_subset_image {r : Rel α β} (h : r.Injective)
    (s : Set β) (t : Set α) :
    s ⊆ r.image t → r.preimage s ⊆ t := by
  rintro hst x ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := hst hy
  cases h.injective hzy hxy
  exact hz

theorem Injective.preimage_subset_iff_subset_image {r : Rel α β} (h : r.Injective)
    (s : Set β) (hs : s ⊆ r.codom) (t : Set α) :
    r.preimage s ⊆ t ↔ s ⊆ r.image t :=
  ⟨subset_image_of_preimage_subset hs t, preimage_subset_of_subset_image h s t⟩

theorem OneOne.preimage_eq_iff_image_eq {r : Rel α β} (h : r.OneOne)
    {s : Set β} (hs : s ⊆ r.codom) {t : Set α} (ht : t ⊆ r.dom) :
    r.preimage s = t ↔ r.image t = s := by
  have h₁ := h.preimage_subset_iff_subset_image s hs t
  have h₂ := h.inv.preimage_subset_iff_subset_image t ht s
  rw [preimage_inv, inv_image] at h₂
  rw [subset_antisymm_iff, subset_antisymm_iff, h₁, h₂, and_comm]

  rw [codomEqDom_iff] at h ⊢

theorem Permutative.inv {r : Rel α α} (h : r.Permutative) : r.inv.Permutative :=
  ⟨h.toOneOne.inv, h.toCodomEqDom.inv⟩

theorem Permutative.inv_dom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.Permutative) : r.inv.dom = r.dom :=

    (r.comp s).Injective := by

  cases hs.injective hs₁ hs₂
  exact hr.injective hr₁ hr₂

    (r.comp s).Coinjective := by
  rw [← inv_injective_iff, comp_inv]
  exact Injective.comp (inv_injective_iff.mpr hs) (inv_injective_iff.mpr hr)

theorem Injective.mono {r s : Rel α β} (hs : s.Injective) (h : r ≤ s) :
    r.Injective := by
  constructor
  intro a₁ a₂ b h₁ h₂
  exact hs.injective (h a₁ b h₁) (h a₂ b h₂)

    r.Coinjective := by

structure Surjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  surjective : ∀ y, ∃ x, r x y

@[mk_iff]
structure Cosurjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  cosurjective : ∀ x, ∃ y, r x y

@[mk_iff]
structure Functional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Coinjective, r.Cosurjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure Cofunctional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Injective, r.Surjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure OneOne (r : Rel α β) extends r.Injective, r.Coinjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure Bijective (r : Rel α β) extends r.Functional, r.Cofunctional : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure CodomEqDom (r : Rel α α) : Prop where
  codom_eq_dom : r.codom = r.dom

@[mk_iff]
structure Permutative (r : Rel α α) extends r.OneOne, r.CodomEqDom : Prop

theorem CodomEqDom.dom_union_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) :
    r.dom ∪ r.codom = r.dom := by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom, union_self]

theorem CodomEqDom.mem_dom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) {x y : α} (hxy : r x y) :
    y ∈ r.dom := by
  rw [← h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨x, hxy⟩

theorem CodomEqDom.mem_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) {x y : α} (hxy : r x y) :
    x ∈ r.codom := by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨y, hxy⟩

/-- An elementary description of the property `CodomEqDom`. -/
theorem codomEqDom_iff' (r : Rel α α) :
    r.CodomEqDom ↔ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r y z) ∧ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r z x) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h⟩
    rw [Set.ext_iff] at h
    constructor
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h y).mp ⟨x, hxy⟩
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h x).mpr ⟨y, hxy⟩
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    constructor
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩
      exact h₁ y x hxy
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩
      exact h₂ x y hxy

theorem inv_injective : Function.Injective (inv : Rel α β → Rel β α) := by

@[simp]
theorem inv_inj {r s : Rel α β} : r.inv = s.inv ↔ r = s :=

@[simp]
theorem inv_injective_iff {r : Rel α β} :

@[simp]

  inv_surjective_iff.symm

@[simp]
theorem inv_functional_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Functional ↔ r.Cofunctional :=
  ⟨λ h ↦ ⟨inv_coinjective_iff.mp h.toCoinjective, inv_cosurjective_iff.mp h.toCosurjective⟩,

@[simp]
theorem inv_cofunctional_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Cofunctional ↔ r.Functional :=
  inv_functional_iff.symm

theorem inv_dom {r : Rel α β} :

@[simp]
theorem inv_codom {r : Rel α β} :

@[mk_iff]

@[mk_iff]

@[mk_iff]
structure Permutative (r : Rel α α) extends r.OneOne, r.CodomEqDom : Prop

theorem CodomEqDom.dom_union_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) :
    r.dom ∪ r.codom = r.dom := by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom, union_self]

theorem CodomEqDom.mem_dom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) {x y : α} (hxy : r x y) :
    y ∈ r.dom := by
  rw [← h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨x, hxy⟩

theorem CodomEqDom.mem_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) {x y : α} (hxy : r x y) :
    x ∈ r.codom := by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨y, hxy⟩

/-- An elementary description of the property `CodomEqDom`. -/
theorem codomEqDom_iff' (r : Rel α α) :
    r.CodomEqDom ↔ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r y z) ∧ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r z x) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h⟩
    rw [Set.ext_iff] at h
    constructor
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h y).mp ⟨x, hxy⟩
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h x).mpr ⟨y, hxy⟩
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    constructor
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩
      exact h₁ y x hxy
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩
      exact h₂ x y hxy

theorem OneOne.inv {r : Rel α β} (h : r.OneOne) : r.inv.OneOne :=
  ⟨⟨h.coinjective⟩, ⟨h.injective⟩⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_apply {r : Rel α β} {x : α} {y : β} :
    r.inv y x ↔ r x y :=
  Iff.rfl

theorem inv_injective : Function.Injective (inv : Rel α β → Rel β α) := by
  intro r s h
  ext a b : 2
  exact congr_fun₂ h b a

@[simp]
theorem inv_inj {r s : Rel α β} : r.inv = s.inv ↔ r = s :=
  ⟨λ h ↦ inv_injective h, λ h ↦ h ▸ rfl⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_injective_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Injective ↔ r.Coinjective :=
  ⟨λ h ↦ ⟨h.injective⟩, λ h ↦ ⟨h.coinjective⟩⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_coinjective_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Coinjective ↔ r.Injective :=
  inv_injective_iff.symm

@[simp]
theorem inv_surjective_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Surjective ↔ r.Cosurjective :=
  ⟨λ h ↦ ⟨h.surjective⟩, λ h ↦ ⟨h.cosurjective⟩⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_cosurjective_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Cosurjective ↔ r.Surjective :=
  inv_surjective_iff.symm

@[simp]
theorem inv_functional_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Functional ↔ r.Cofunctional :=
  ⟨λ h ↦ ⟨inv_coinjective_iff.mp h.toCoinjective, inv_cosurjective_iff.mp h.toCosurjective⟩,
    λ h ↦ ⟨inv_injective_iff.mp h.toInjective, inv_surjective_iff.mp h.toSurjective⟩⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_cofunctional_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Cofunctional ↔ r.Functional :=
  inv_functional_iff.symm

@[simp]
theorem inv_dom {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.dom = r.codom :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem inv_codom {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.codom = r.dom :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem inv_image {r : Rel α β} {s : Set β} :
    r.inv.image s = r.preimage s :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem inv_preimage {r : Rel α β} {s : Set α} :
    r.inv.preimage s = r.image s :=
  rfl

theorem comp_inv {r : Rel α β} {s : Rel β γ} :
    (r.comp s).inv = s.inv.comp r.inv := by
  ext c a
  simp only [inv, flip, comp]
  tauto

theorem Injective.image_injective {r : Rel α β} (h : r.Injective) {s t : Set α}
    (hs : s ⊆ r.dom) (ht : t ⊆ r.dom) (hst : r.image s = r.image t) : s = t := by
  rw [Set.ext_iff] at hst ⊢
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ := hs hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := (hst y).mp ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
    cases h.injective hxy hzy
    exact hz
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ := ht hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := (hst y).mpr ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
    cases h.injective hxy hzy
    exact hz

theorem subset_image_of_preimage_subset {r : Rel α β} {s : Set β} (hs : s ⊆ r.codom) (t : Set α) :
    r.preimage s ⊆ t → s ⊆ r.image t := by
  intro hst y hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hs hy
  exact ⟨x, hst ⟨y, hy, hx⟩, hx⟩

theorem Injective.preimage_subset_of_subset_image {r : Rel α β} (h : r.Injective)
    (s : Set β) (t : Set α) :
    s ⊆ r.image t → r.preimage s ⊆ t := by
  rintro hst x ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := hst hy
  cases h.injective hzy hxy
  exact hz

theorem Injective.preimage_subset_iff_subset_image {r : Rel α β} (h : r.Injective)
    (s : Set β) (hs : s ⊆ r.codom) (t : Set α) :
    r.preimage s ⊆ t ↔ s ⊆ r.image t :=
  ⟨subset_image_of_preimage_subset hs t, preimage_subset_of_subset_image h s t⟩

theorem OneOne.preimage_eq_iff_image_eq {r : Rel α β} (h : r.OneOne)
    {s : Set β} (hs : s ⊆ r.codom) {t : Set α} (ht : t ⊆ r.dom) :
    r.preimage s = t ↔ r.image t = s := by
  have h₁ := h.preimage_subset_iff_subset_image s hs t
  have h₂ := h.inv.preimage_subset_iff_subset_image t ht s
  rw [preimage_inv, inv_image] at h₂
  rw [subset_antisymm_iff, subset_antisymm_iff, h₁, h₂, and_comm]

theorem CodomEqDom.inv {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) : r.inv.CodomEqDom := by
  rw [codomEqDom_iff] at h ⊢
  exact h.symm

theorem Permutative.inv {r : Rel α α} (h : r.Permutative) : r.inv.Permutative :=
  ⟨h.toOneOne.inv, h.toCodomEqDom.inv⟩

theorem Permutative.inv_dom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.Permutative) : r.inv.dom = r.dom :=
  h.codom_eq_dom

theorem Injective.comp {r : Rel α β} {s : Rel β γ} (hr : r.Injective) (hs : s.Injective) :
    (r.comp s).Injective := by
  constructor
  rintro a₁ a₂ c ⟨b₁, hr₁, hs₁⟩ ⟨b₂, hr₂, hs₂⟩
  cases hs.injective hs₁ hs₂
  exact hr.injective hr₁ hr₂

theorem Coinjective.comp {r : Rel α β} {s : Rel β γ} (hr : r.Coinjective) (hs : s.Coinjective) :
    (r.comp s).Coinjective := by
  rw [← inv_injective_iff, comp_inv]
  exact Injective.comp (inv_injective_iff.mpr hs) (inv_injective_iff.mpr hr)

theorem Injective.mono {r s : Rel α β} (hs : s.Injective) (h : r ≤ s) :
    r.Injective := by
  constructor
  intro a₁ a₂ b h₁ h₂
  exact hs.injective (h a₁ b h₁) (h a₂ b h₂)

theorem Coinjective.mono {r s : Rel α β} (hs : s.Coinjective) (h : r ≤ s) :
    r.Coinjective := by
  constructor
  intro b₁ b₂ a h₁ h₂
  exact hs.coinjective (h a b₁ h₁) (h a b₂ h₂)

theorem OneOne.mono {r s : Rel α β} (hs : s.OneOne) (h : r ≤ s) :
    r.OneOne :=
  ⟨hs.toInjective.mono h, hs.toCoinjective.mono h⟩

/-- An alternative spelling of `Rel.graph` that is useful for proving inequalities of cardinals. -/
def graph' (r : Rel α β) : Set (α × β) :=
  r.uncurry

    y ∈ r.dom := by
  rw [← h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨x, hxy⟩

  rw [h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨y, hxy⟩

    rw [Set.ext_iff] at h
    constructor
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h y).mp ⟨x, hxy⟩
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h x).mpr ⟨y, hxy⟩
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    constructor
    ext x

    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩

  intro r s h

  rw [Set.ext_iff] at hst ⊢
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ := hs hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := (hst y).mp ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
    cases h.injective hxy hzy
    exact hz
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ := ht hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := (hst y).mpr ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
    cases h.injective hxy hzy
    exact hz

theorem subset_image_of_preimage_subset {r : Rel α β} {s : Set β} (hs : s ⊆ r.codom) (t : Set α) :
    r.preimage s ⊆ t → s ⊆ r.image t := by
  intro hst y hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hs hy
  exact ⟨x, hst ⟨y, hy, hx⟩, hx⟩

theorem Injective.preimage_subset_of_subset_image {r : Rel α β} (h : r.Injective)
    (s : Set β) (t : Set α) :
    s ⊆ r.image t → r.preimage s ⊆ t := by
  rintro hst x ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := hst hy
  cases h.injective hzy hxy
  exact hz

theorem Injective.preimage_subset_iff_subset_image {r : Rel α β} (h : r.Injective)
    (s : Set β) (hs : s ⊆ r.codom) (t : Set α) :
    r.preimage s ⊆ t ↔ s ⊆ r.image t :=
  ⟨subset_image_of_preimage_subset hs t, preimage_subset_of_subset_image h s t⟩

theorem OneOne.preimage_eq_iff_image_eq {r : Rel α β} (h : r.OneOne)
    {s : Set β} (hs : s ⊆ r.codom) {t : Set α} (ht : t ⊆ r.dom) :
    r.preimage s = t ↔ r.image t = s := by
  have h₁ := h.preimage_subset_iff_subset_image s hs t
  have h₂ := h.inv.preimage_subset_iff_subset_image t ht s
  rw [preimage_inv, inv_image] at h₂

import Mathlib.Data.Rel
import Mathlib.Order.Chain

open Set
open scoped symmDiff

namespace Rel

variable {α β γ : Type _}

def field (r : Rel α α) : Set α :=
  r.dom ∪ r.codom

@[mk_iff]
structure Injective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  injective : ∀ ⦃x₁ x₂ y⦄, r x₁ y → r x₂ y → x₁ = x₂

@[mk_iff]
structure Coinjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  coinjective : ∀ ⦃y₁ y₂ x⦄, r x y₁ → r x y₂ → y₁ = y₂

@[mk_iff]
structure Surjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  surjective : ∀ y, ∃ x, r x y

@[mk_iff]
structure Cosurjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  cosurjective : ∀ x, ∃ y, r x y

@[mk_iff]
structure Functional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Coinjective, r.Cosurjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure Cofunctional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Injective, r.Surjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure OneOne (r : Rel α β) extends r.Injective, r.Coinjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure Bijective (r : Rel α β) extends r.Functional, r.Cofunctional : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure CodomEqDom (r : Rel α α) : Prop where
  codom_eq_dom : r.codom = r.dom

@[mk_iff]
structure Permutative (r : Rel α α) extends r.OneOne, r.CodomEqDom : Prop

theorem CodomEqDom.dom_union_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) :
    r.dom ∪ r.codom = r.dom := by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom, union_self]

theorem CodomEqDom.mem_dom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) {x y : α} (hxy : r x y) :
    y ∈ r.dom := by
  rw [← h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨x, hxy⟩

theorem CodomEqDom.mem_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) {x y : α} (hxy : r x y) :
    x ∈ r.codom := by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨y, hxy⟩

/-- An elementary description of the property `CodomEqDom`. -/
theorem codomEqDom_iff' (r : Rel α α) :
    r.CodomEqDom ↔ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r y z) ∧ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r z x) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h⟩
    rw [Set.ext_iff] at h
    constructor
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h y).mp ⟨x, hxy⟩
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h x).mpr ⟨y, hxy⟩
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    constructor
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩
      exact h₁ y x hxy
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩
      exact h₂ x y hxy

theorem OneOne.inv {r : Rel α β} (h : r.OneOne) : r.inv.OneOne :=
  ⟨⟨h.coinjective⟩, ⟨h.injective⟩⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_apply {r : Rel α β} {x : α} {y : β} :
    r.inv y x ↔ r x y :=
  Iff.rfl

theorem inv_injective : Function.Injective (inv : Rel α β → Rel β α) := by
  intro r s h
  ext a b : 2
  exact congr_fun₂ h b a

@[simp]
theorem inv_inj {r s : Rel α β} : r.inv = s.inv ↔ r = s :=
  ⟨λ h ↦ inv_injective h, λ h ↦ h ▸ rfl⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_injective_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Injective ↔ r.Coinjective :=
  ⟨λ h ↦ ⟨h.injective⟩, λ h ↦ ⟨h.coinjective⟩⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_coinjective_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Coinjective ↔ r.Injective :=
  inv_injective_iff.symm

@[simp]
theorem inv_surjective_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Surjective ↔ r.Cosurjective :=
  ⟨λ h ↦ ⟨h.surjective⟩, λ h ↦ ⟨h.cosurjective⟩⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_cosurjective_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Cosurjective ↔ r.Surjective :=
  inv_surjective_iff.symm

@[simp]
theorem inv_functional_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Functional ↔ r.Cofunctional :=
  ⟨λ h ↦ ⟨inv_coinjective_iff.mp h.toCoinjective, inv_cosurjective_iff.mp h.toCosurjective⟩,
    λ h ↦ ⟨inv_injective_iff.mp h.toInjective, inv_surjective_iff.mp h.toSurjective⟩⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_cofunctional_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Cofunctional ↔ r.Functional :=
  inv_functional_iff.symm

@[simp]
theorem inv_dom {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.dom = r.codom :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem inv_codom {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.codom = r.dom :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem inv_image {r : Rel α β} {s : Set β} :
    r.inv.image s = r.preimage s :=
  rfl

@[simp]
theorem inv_preimage {r : Rel α β} {s : Set α} :
    r.inv.preimage s = r.image s :=
  rfl

theorem comp_inv {r : Rel α β} {s : Rel β γ} :
    (r.comp s).inv = s.inv.comp r.inv := by
  ext c a
  simp only [inv, flip, comp]
  tauto

theorem Injective.image_injective {r : Rel α β} (h : r.Injective) {s t : Set α}
    (hs : s ⊆ r.dom) (ht : t ⊆ r.dom) (hst : r.image s = r.image t) : s = t := by
  rw [Set.ext_iff] at hst ⊢
  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ := hs hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := (hst y).mp ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
    cases h.injective hxy hzy
    exact hz
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨y, hxy⟩ := ht hx
    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := (hst y).mpr ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩
    cases h.injective hxy hzy
    exact hz

theorem subset_image_of_preimage_subset {r : Rel α β} {s : Set β} (hs : s ⊆ r.codom) (t : Set α) :
    r.preimage s ⊆ t → s ⊆ r.image t := by
  intro hst y hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hs hy
  exact ⟨x, hst ⟨y, hy, hx⟩, hx⟩

theorem Injective.preimage_subset_of_subset_image {r : Rel α β} (h : r.Injective)
    (s : Set β) (t : Set α) :
    s ⊆ r.image t → r.preimage s ⊆ t := by
  rintro hst x ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := hst hy
  cases h.injective hzy hxy
  exact hz

theorem Injective.preimage_subset_iff_subset_image {r : Rel α β} (h : r.Injective)
    (s : Set β) (hs : s ⊆ r.codom) (t : Set α) :
    r.preimage s ⊆ t ↔ s ⊆ r.image t :=
  ⟨subset_image_of_preimage_subset hs t, preimage_subset_of_subset_image h s t⟩

theorem OneOne.preimage_eq_iff_image_eq {r : Rel α β} (h : r.OneOne)
    {s : Set β} (hs : s ⊆ r.codom) {t : Set α} (ht : t ⊆ r.dom) :
    r.preimage s = t ↔ r.image t = s := by
  have h₁ := h.preimage_subset_iff_subset_image s hs t
  have h₂ := h.inv.preimage_subset_iff_subset_image t ht s
  rw [preimage_inv, inv_image] at h₂
  rw [subset_antisymm_iff, subset_antisymm_iff, h₁, h₂, and_comm]

theorem CodomEqDom.inv {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) : r.inv.CodomEqDom := by
  rw [codomEqDom_iff] at h ⊢
  exact h.symm

theorem Permutative.inv {r : Rel α α} (h : r.Permutative) : r.inv.Permutative :=
  ⟨h.toOneOne.inv, h.toCodomEqDom.inv⟩

theorem Permutative.inv_dom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.Permutative) : r.inv.dom = r.dom :=
  h.codom_eq_dom

theorem Injective.comp {r : Rel α β} {s : Rel β γ} (hr : r.Injective) (hs : s.Injective) :
    (r.comp s).Injective := by
  constructor
  rintro a₁ a₂ c ⟨b₁, hr₁, hs₁⟩ ⟨b₂, hr₂, hs₂⟩
  cases hs.injective hs₁ hs₂
  exact hr.injective hr₁ hr₂

theorem Coinjective.comp {r : Rel α β} {s : Rel β γ} (hr : r.Coinjective) (hs : s.Coinjective) :
    (r.comp s).Coinjective := by
  rw [← inv_injective_iff, comp_inv]
  exact Injective.comp (inv_injective_iff.mpr hs) (inv_injective_iff.mpr hr)

theorem Injective.mono {r s : Rel α β} (hs : s.Injective) (h : r ≤ s) :
    r.Injective := by
  constructor
  intro a₁ a₂ b h₁ h₂
  exact hs.injective (h a₁ b h₁) (h a₂ b h₂)

theorem Coinjective.mono {r s : Rel α β} (hs : s.Coinjective) (h : r ≤ s) :
    r.Coinjective := by
  exact?

  intro x
  constructor
  · intro hx

    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := (hst y).mp ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩

    exact hz
  · intro hx

    obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := (hst y).mpr ⟨x, hx, hxy⟩

  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hs hy
  exact ⟨x, hst ⟨y, hy, hx⟩, hx⟩

  rintro hst x ⟨y, hy, hxy⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := hst hy
  cases h.injective hzy hxy
  exact hz

theorem Injective.preimage_subset_iff_subset_image {r : Rel α β} (h : r.Injective)
    (s : Set β) (hs : s ⊆ r.codom) (t : Set α) :
    r.preimage s ⊆ t ↔ s ⊆ r.image t :=

theorem CodomEqDom.dom_union_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) :

  exact ⟨x, hxy⟩

theorem codomEqDom_iff' (r : Rel α α) :

  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h⟩
    rw [Set.ext_iff] at h
    constructor
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h y).mp ⟨x, hxy⟩
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h x).mpr ⟨y, hxy⟩
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    constructor
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩
      exact h₁ y x hxy
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩

@[mk_iff]
structure Cofunctional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Injective, r.Surjective : Prop

structure OneOne (r : Rel α β) extends r.Injective, r.Coinjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure Bijective (r : Rel α β) extends r.Functional, r.Cofunctional : Prop

  codom_eq_dom : r.codom = r.dom

@[mk_iff]
structure Permutative (r : Rel α α) extends r.OneOne, r.CodomEqDom : Prop

theorem CodomEqDom.dom_union_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) :
    r.dom ∪ r.codom = r.dom := by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom, union_self]

    y ∈ r.dom := by
  rw [← h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨x, hxy⟩

  rw [h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨y, hxy⟩

  constructor

    rw [Set.ext_iff] at h
    constructor
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h y).mp ⟨x, hxy⟩
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h x).mpr ⟨y, hxy⟩
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    constructor
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩

    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩

    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩

import Mathlib.Order.Chain

open Set
open scoped symmDiff

namespace Rel

variable {α β γ : Type _}

def field (r : Rel α α) : Set α :=
  r.dom ∪ r.codom

@[mk_iff]
structure Injective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  injective : ∀ ⦃x₁ x₂ y⦄, r x₁ y → r x₂ y → x₁ = x₂

@[mk_iff]
structure Coinjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  coinjective : ∀ ⦃y₁ y₂ x⦄, r x y₁ → r x y₂ → y₁ = y₂

@[mk_iff]
structure Surjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  surjective : ∀ y, ∃ x, r x y

@[mk_iff]
structure Cosurjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  cosurjective : ∀ x, ∃ y, r x y

@[mk_iff]
structure Functional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Coinjective, r.Cosurjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure Cofunctional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Injective, r.Surjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure OneOne (r : Rel α β) extends r.Injective, r.Coinjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure Bijective (r : Rel α β) extends r.Functional, r.Cofunctional : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure CodomEqDom (r : Rel α α) : Prop where
  codom_eq_dom : r.codom = r.dom

@[mk_iff]
structure Permutative (r : Rel α α) extends r.OneOne, r.CodomEqDom : Prop

theorem CodomEqDom.dom_union_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) :
    r.dom ∪ r.codom = r.dom := by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom, union_self]

theorem CodomEqDom.mem_dom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) {x y : α} (hxy : r x y) :
    y ∈ r.dom := by
  rw [← h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨x, hxy⟩

theorem CodomEqDom.mem_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) {x y : α} (hxy : r x y) :
    x ∈ r.codom := by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨y, hxy⟩

/-- An elementary description of the property `CodomEqDom`. -/
theorem codomEqDom_iff' (r : Rel α α) :
    r.CodomEqDom ↔ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r y z) ∧ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r z x) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h⟩
    rw [Set.ext_iff] at h
    constructor
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h y).mp ⟨x, hxy⟩
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h x).mpr ⟨y, hxy⟩
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    constructor
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩
      exact h₁ y x hxy
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩
      exact h₂ x y hxy

theorem OneOne.inv {r : Rel α β} (h : r.OneOne) : r.inv.OneOne :=
  ⟨⟨h.coinjective⟩, ⟨h.injective⟩⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_apply {r : Rel α β} {x : α} {y : β} :
    r.inv y x ↔ r x y :=
  Iff.rfl

theorem inv_injective : Function.Injective (inv : Rel α β → Rel β α) := by
  intro r s h
  ext a b : 2
  exact congr_fun₂ h b a

@[simp]
theorem inv_inj {r s : Rel α β} : r.inv = s.inv ↔ r = s :=
  ⟨λ h ↦ inv_injective h, λ h ↦ h ▸ rfl⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_injective_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Injective ↔ r.Coinjective :=
  ⟨λ h ↦ ⟨h.injective⟩, λ h ↦ ⟨h.coinjective⟩⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_coinjective_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Coinjective ↔ r.Injective :=
  inv_injective_iff.symm

@[simp]
theorem inv_surjective_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Surjective ↔ r.Cosurjective :=
  ⟨λ h ↦ ⟨h.surjective⟩, λ h ↦ ⟨h.cosurjective⟩⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_cosurjective_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Cosurjective ↔ r.Surjective :=
  inv_surjective_iff.symm

@[simp]
theorem inv_functional_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Functional ↔ r.Cofunctional :=
  ⟨λ h ↦ ⟨inv_coinjective_iff.mp h.toCoinjective, inv_cosurjective_iff.mp h.toCosurjective⟩,
    λ h ↦ ⟨inv_injective_iff.mp h.toInjective, inv_surjective_iff.mp h.toSurjective⟩⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_cofunctional_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Cofunctional ↔ r.Functional :=
  inv_functional_iff.symm

@[simp]
theorem inv_dom {r : Rel α β} :

@[simp]
theorem inv_codom {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.codom = r.dom :=

    r.inv.image s = r.preimage s :=

@[simp]
theorem inv_preimage {r : Rel α β} {s : Set α} :
    r.inv.preimage s = r.image s :=
  rfl

theorem comp_inv {r : Rel α β} {s : Rel β γ} :
    (r.comp s).inv = s.inv.comp r.inv := by
  ext c a
  simp only [inv, flip, comp]
  tauto

  coinjective : ∀ ⦃y₁ y₂ x⦄, r x y₁ → r x y₂ → y₁ = y₂

@[mk_iff]
structure Surjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  surjective : ∀ y, ∃ x, r x y

@[mk_iff]

  cosurjective : ∀ x, ∃ y, r x y

structure Functional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Coinjective, r.Cosurjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure Cofunctional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Injective, r.Surjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure OneOne (r : Rel α β) extends r.Injective, r.Coinjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure Bijective (r : Rel α β) extends r.Functional, r.Cofunctional : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure CodomEqDom (r : Rel α α) : Prop where
  codom_eq_dom : r.codom = r.dom

@[mk_iff]
structure Permutative (r : Rel α α) extends r.OneOne, r.CodomEqDom : Prop

    r.dom ∪ r.codom = r.dom := by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom, union_self]

    y ∈ r.dom := by
  rw [← h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨x, hxy⟩

    x ∈ r.codom := by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨y, hxy⟩

    r.CodomEqDom ↔ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r y z) ∧ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r z x) := by

    rw [Set.ext_iff] at h

@[mk_iff]
structure Coinjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  coinjective : ∀ ⦃y₁ y₂ x⦄, r x y₁ → r x y₂ → y₁ = y₂

@[mk_iff]
structure Surjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  surjective : ∀ y, ∃ x, r x y

@[mk_iff]
structure Cosurjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  cosurjective : ∀ x, ∃ y, r x y

@[mk_iff]
structure Functional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Coinjective, r.Cosurjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure Cofunctional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Injective, r.Surjective : Prop

  coinjective : ∀ ⦃y₁ y₂ x⦄, r x y₁ → r x y₂ → y₁ = y₂

@[mk_iff]
structure Surjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  surjective : ∀ y, ∃ x, r x y

@[mk_iff]
structure Cosurjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  cosurjective : ∀ x, ∃ y, r x y

structure Functional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Coinjective, r.Cosurjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure Cofunctional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Injective, r.Surjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure OneOne (r : Rel α β) extends r.Injective, r.Coinjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure Bijective (r : Rel α β) extends r.Functional, r.Cofunctional : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure CodomEqDom (r : Rel α α) : Prop where
  codom_eq_dom : r.codom = r.dom

@[mk_iff]
structure Permutative (r : Rel α α) extends r.OneOne, r.CodomEqDom : Prop

theorem CodomEqDom.dom_union_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) :
    r.dom ∪ r.codom = r.dom := by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom, union_self]

theorem CodomEqDom.mem_dom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) {x y : α} (hxy : r x y) :
    y ∈ r.dom := by
  rw [← h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨x, hxy⟩

theorem CodomEqDom.mem_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) {x y : α} (hxy : r x y) :
    x ∈ r.codom := by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨y, hxy⟩

theorem codomEqDom_iff' (r : Rel α α) :
    r.CodomEqDom ↔ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r y z) ∧ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r z x) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h⟩
    rw [Set.ext_iff] at h
    constructor
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h y).mp ⟨x, hxy⟩
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h x).mpr ⟨y, hxy⟩
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    constructor
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩
      exact h₁ y x hxy
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩
      exact h₂ x y hxy

import Mathlib.Data.Rel
import Mathlib.Order.Chain

open Set
open scoped symmDiff

namespace Rel

variable {α β γ : Type _}

def field (r : Rel α α) : Set α :=
  r.dom ∪ r.codom

@[mk_iff]
structure Injective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  injective : ∀ ⦃x₁ x₂ y⦄, r x₁ y → r x₂ y → x₁ = x₂

@[mk_iff]
structure Coinjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  coinjective : ∀ ⦃y₁ y₂ x⦄, r x y₁ → r x y₂ → y₁ = y₂

@[mk_iff]
structure Surjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  surjective : ∀ y, ∃ x, r x y

@[mk_iff]
structure Cosurjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  cosurjective : ∀ x, ∃ y, r x y

@[mk_iff]
structure Functional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Coinjective, r.Cosurjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure Cofunctional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Injective, r.Surjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure OneOne (r : Rel α β) extends r.Injective, r.Coinjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure Bijective (r : Rel α β) extends r.Functional, r.Cofunctional : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure CodomEqDom (r : Rel α α) : Prop where
  codom_eq_dom : r.codom = r.dom

@[mk_iff]
structure Permutative (r : Rel α α) extends r.OneOne, r.CodomEqDom : Prop

theorem CodomEqDom.dom_union_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) :
    r.dom ∪ r.codom = r.dom := by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom, union_self]

theorem CodomEqDom.mem_dom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) {x y : α} (hxy : r x y) :
    y ∈ r.dom := by
  rw [← h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨x, hxy⟩

theorem CodomEqDom.mem_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) {x y : α} (hxy : r x y) :
    x ∈ r.codom := by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨y, hxy⟩

/-- An elementary description of the property `CodomEqDom`. -/
theorem codomEqDom_iff' (r : Rel α α) :
    r.CodomEqDom ↔ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r y z) ∧ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r z x) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h⟩
    rw [Set.ext_iff] at h
    constructor
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h y).mp ⟨x, hxy⟩
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h x).mpr ⟨y, hxy⟩
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    constructor
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩
      exact h₁ y x hxy
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩
      exact h₂ x y hxy

theorem OneOne.inv {r : Rel α β} (h : r.OneOne) : r.inv.OneOne :=
  ⟨⟨h.coinjective⟩, ⟨h.injective⟩⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_apply {r : Rel α β} {x : α} {y : β} :
    r.inv y x ↔ r x y :=
  Iff.rfl

theorem inv_injective : Function.Injective (inv : Rel α β → Rel β α) := by
  intro r s h
  ext a b : 2
  exact congr_fun₂ h b a

@[simp]
theorem inv_inj {r s : Rel α β} : r.inv = s.inv ↔ r = s :=
  ⟨λ h ↦ inv_injective h, λ h ↦ h ▸ rfl⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_injective_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Injective ↔ r.Coinjective :=
  ⟨λ h ↦ ⟨h.injective⟩, λ h ↦ ⟨h.coinjective⟩⟩

@[simp]

    r.inv.Coinjective ↔ r.Injective :=
  inv_injective_iff.symm

@[simp]
theorem inv_surjective_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Surjective ↔ r.Cosurjective :=
  ⟨λ h ↦ ⟨h.surjective⟩, λ h ↦ ⟨h.cosurjective⟩⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_cosurjective_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Cosurjective ↔ r.Surjective :=
  inv_surjective_iff.symm

@[simp]
theorem inv_functional_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Functional ↔ r.Cofunctional :=
  ⟨λ h ↦ ⟨inv_coinjective_iff.mp h.toCoinjective, inv_cosurjective_iff.mp h.toCosurjective⟩,
    λ h ↦ ⟨inv_injective_iff.mp h.toInjective, inv_surjective_iff.mp h.toSurjective⟩⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_cofunctional_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Cofunctional ↔ r.Functional :=
  inv_functional_iff.symm

    r.inv.preimage s = r.image s :=

@[mk_iff]
structure Surjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  surjective : ∀ y, ∃ x, r x y

@[mk_iff]

@[mk_iff]
structure Functional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Coinjective, r.Cosurjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure Cofunctional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Injective, r.Surjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure OneOne (r : Rel α β) extends r.Injective, r.Coinjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]

@[mk_iff]
structure Permutative (r : Rel α α) extends r.OneOne, r.CodomEqDom : Prop

theorem CodomEqDom.dom_union_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) :
    r.dom ∪ r.codom = r.dom := by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom, union_self]

theorem CodomEqDom.mem_dom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) {x y : α} (hxy : r x y) :
    y ∈ r.dom := by
  rw [← h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨x, hxy⟩

theorem CodomEqDom.mem_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) {x y : α} (hxy : r x y) :
    x ∈ r.codom := by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨y, hxy⟩

theorem codomEqDom_iff' (r : Rel α α) :
    r.CodomEqDom ↔ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r y z) ∧ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r z x) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h⟩
    rw [Set.ext_iff] at h
    constructor
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h y).mp ⟨x, hxy⟩
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h x).mpr ⟨y, hxy⟩
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    constructor
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩
      exact h₁ y x hxy
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩
      exact h₂ x y hxy

theorem OneOne.inv {r : Rel α β} (h : r.OneOne) : r.inv.OneOne :=
  ⟨⟨h.coinjective⟩, ⟨h.injective⟩⟩

theorem inv_apply {r : Rel α β} {x : α} {y : β} :
    r.inv y x ↔ r x y :=

theorem inv_injective : Function.Injective (inv : Rel α β → Rel β α) := by
  intro r s h
  ext a b : 2
  exact congr_fun₂ h b a

@[simp]
theorem inv_inj {r s : Rel α β} : r.inv = s.inv ↔ r = s :=
  ⟨λ h ↦ inv_injective h, λ h ↦ h ▸ rfl⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_injective_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Injective ↔ r.Coinjective :=
  ⟨λ h ↦ ⟨h.injective⟩, λ h ↦ ⟨h.coinjective⟩⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_coinjective_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Coinjective ↔ r.Injective :=
  inv_injective_iff.symm

@[simp]
theorem inv_surjective_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Surjective ↔ r.Cosurjective :=
  ⟨λ h ↦ ⟨h.surjective⟩, λ h ↦ ⟨h.cosurjective⟩⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_cosurjective_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Cosurjective ↔ r.Surjective :=
  inv_surjective_iff.symm

@[simp]
theorem inv_functional_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Functional ↔ r.Cofunctional :=
  ⟨λ h ↦ ⟨inv_coinjective_iff.mp h.toCoinjective, inv_cosurjective_iff.mp h.toCosurjective⟩,
    λ h ↦ ⟨inv_injective_iff.mp h.toInjective, inv_surjective_iff.mp h.toSurjective⟩⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_cofunctional_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Cofunctional ↔ r.Functional :=
  inv_functional_iff.symm

theorem inv_dom {r : Rel α β} :

@[simp]
theorem inv_codom {r : Rel α β} :

theorem inv_image {r : Rel α β} {s : Set β} :
    r.inv.image s = r.preimage s :=

theorem inv_preimage {r : Rel α β} {s : Set α} :

  tauto

import Mathlib.Order.Chain

open Set
open scoped symmDiff

namespace Rel

variable {α β γ : Type _}

def field (r : Rel α α) : Set α :=
  r.dom ∪ r.codom

@[mk_iff]
structure Injective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  injective : ∀ ⦃x₁ x₂ y⦄, r x₁ y → r x₂ y → x₁ = x₂

@[mk_iff]
structure Coinjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  coinjective : ∀ ⦃y₁ y₂ x⦄, r x y₁ → r x y₂ → y₁ = y₂

@[mk_iff]
structure Surjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  surjective : ∀ y, ∃ x, r x y

@[mk_iff]
structure Cosurjective (r : Rel α β) : Prop where
  cosurjective : ∀ x, ∃ y, r x y

@[mk_iff]
structure Functional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Coinjective, r.Cosurjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure Cofunctional (r : Rel α β) extends r.Injective, r.Surjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure OneOne (r : Rel α β) extends r.Injective, r.Coinjective : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure Bijective (r : Rel α β) extends r.Functional, r.Cofunctional : Prop

@[mk_iff]
structure CodomEqDom (r : Rel α α) : Prop where
  codom_eq_dom : r.codom = r.dom

@[mk_iff]
structure Permutative (r : Rel α α) extends r.OneOne, r.CodomEqDom : Prop

theorem CodomEqDom.dom_union_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) :
    r.dom ∪ r.codom = r.dom := by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom, union_self]

theorem CodomEqDom.mem_dom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) {x y : α} (hxy : r x y) :
    y ∈ r.dom := by
  rw [← h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨x, hxy⟩

theorem CodomEqDom.mem_codom {r : Rel α α} (h : r.CodomEqDom) {x y : α} (hxy : r x y) :
    x ∈ r.codom := by
  rw [h.codom_eq_dom]
  exact ⟨y, hxy⟩

/-- An elementary description of the property `CodomEqDom`. -/
theorem codomEqDom_iff' (r : Rel α α) :
    r.CodomEqDom ↔ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r y z) ∧ (∀ x y, r x y → ∃ z, r z x) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h⟩
    rw [Set.ext_iff] at h
    constructor
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h y).mp ⟨x, hxy⟩
    · intro x y hxy
      exact (h x).mpr ⟨y, hxy⟩
  · rintro ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
    constructor
    ext x
    constructor
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩
      exact h₁ y x hxy
    · intro ⟨y, hxy⟩
      exact h₂ x y hxy

  ⟨⟨h.coinjective⟩, ⟨h.injective⟩⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_apply {r : Rel α β} {x : α} {y : β} :
    r.inv y x ↔ r x y :=
  Iff.rfl

theorem inv_injective : Function.Injective (inv : Rel α β → Rel β α) := by
  intro r s h
  ext a b : 2
  exact congr_fun₂ h b a

@[simp]
theorem inv_inj {r s : Rel α β} : r.inv = s.inv ↔ r = s :=
  ⟨λ h ↦ inv_injective h, λ h ↦ h ▸ rfl⟩

@[simp]
theorem inv_injective_iff {r : Rel α β} :
    r.inv.Injective ↔ r.Coinjective :=
  ⟨λ h ↦ ⟨h.injective⟩, λ h ↦ ⟨h.coinjective⟩⟩
